title: Wordmark
slide_intent: Choose a horizontal signature without losing the fuller identity context so a constrained format still reads as the same brand.
strategic_value: A supporting wordmark can extend Burger King into wide formats while preserving the primary logo’s precedence.
demonstration: Two red Burger King wordmarks compare the registered asset and the unregistered restaurant-signage version.
practical_value: Use the wordmark as additional branding in horizontal formats, alongside other brand elements.

content_islands.name: Wordmark usage
content_islands.spec: Place the hierarchy and context instructions at left, followed by the signage-registration consultation note.

content_islands.name: Registered wordmark
content_islands.spec: Place the long red wordmark at upper right with its registration caption.

content_islands.name: Signage wordmark
content_islands.spec: Repeat it below without registration, explicitly captioned for restaurant signage only.

reference_purposes.Application: The page identifies horizontal formats as the wordmark’s role and compares two supplied versions.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The primary logo should appear more often; the wordmark must not be used alone without other branding elements.

ingredient.name: Horizontal wordmark
ingredient.role: Add identification where horizontal space favors a long signature.
ingredient.application: Use it as supporting branding with other brand elements; retain greater use of the primary logo.
ingredient.scope: Historical guide; restaurant-signage registration remains subject to BKC marketing/legal guidance.
